newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices fall hard tracking NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices fall hard tracking NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply by 1.25 to 1.50 cents a gallon on Friday tracking NYMEX heating oil futures and additional softening of cash differentials in U.S. Gulf Coast markets, traders said.
New York Harbor markets meanwhile remained terribly illiquid, with diffs steady and no deals confirmed.

USG 54-grade barrels for any month delivery got done at 1.45 cents over April NYMEX heating oil. Prompt barrels weakened a bit to between 1.60 and 1.90 cents over April NYMEX, USG low sulphur 55-grade was the same as 54-grade for prompts, but about 0.25 firmer on any month barrels.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
